permissionModes.full: gemini --approval-mode yolo: every tool call runs without an approval prompt

unsupported.reason: Gemini CLI has no automatic reviewer: its auto_edit mode only skips edit prompts by rule, so Approve for me is not offered
headless Gemini CLI excludes its ask_user tool
with --approval-mode yolo no approval reaches LUNA; the other headless modes drop the tools that would need one
this provider sends the prompt text only
headless Gemini CLI takes one prompt per process; a message sent during a turn runs after it

limitations: Gemini CLI uses its own sign-in (~/.gemini). LUNA gives the worker only PATH, HOME, USER, SHELL, locale and TMPDIR, so an API key exported in a shell profile does not reach Gemini; ~/.gemini/.env and the OAuth login do.
Models are the installed Gemini CLI's own catalog; whether your account may use one is decided by Google when the message runs.
